scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section prominently displays the product name, tagline, and value proposition with clear call-to-action buttons

steps.context: User is accessing the landing page for the first time

steps.description: Confirm 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and visible

test_cases.input: Load landing page and query for product name element

'Get Started' button is visible and has correct styling
'View on GitHub' button is visible and links to GitHub repository
